title: DAW integration: a device that keeps a sample track sounding the chords you play
description:
## Intent

As a producer, I want a device inside the DAW that embeds the Apricity engine, reads the set's key and the chords played on a MIDI track, and keeps a chosen clip from the library warped and transposed to sound those chords in real time, so that I can play chords on a keyboard and a loop follows.

## Scope

- Max device (or a native plugin) hosting the engine; the harmony solver already does the hard part.
- Inputs: MIDI chords, set tempo and key. Output: audio, re-rendered ahead and swapped at the bar.
- Pushes the set's tempo and key into the Apricity editor so a score is always written against the set it lives in.

## Depends on

- Transport and tempo sync initiative.

## Definition of done

- Holding a chord changes the loop's transposition on the next bar with no dropout.
- Stories for chord change, key change, tempo change.
